name: Pickles (Bread and Butter)
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO diet as they're fermented and contain beneficial acids that may help with bacterial balance.
preparationTips: Choose brands without high-fructose corn syrup or excess garlic/onion
Rinse if very salty to reduce sodium content
Store opened jars in refrigerator and use within recommended timeframe
Check ingredient list for FODMAP-containing additives like garlic powder
alternatives: Dill pickles (often lower in added sugars)
Homemade cucumber pickles with safe sweeteners
Fresh cucumber with vinegar and herbs
nutritionalHighlights: Low in calories (about 5-10 calories per serving)
Provides small amounts of vitamin K
